assumptions.statement: The submitted site and three key-area polygons are provisional rough geometries supplied by the repository, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: Every spatial layer and area metric must be clipped and recalculated when official organiser polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities, drainage, fire access, rail interfaces, and engineering constraints are not in the public package.
assumptions.impact: Widths, heights, FAR, total floor area, demolition, permanent works, and event capacity remain unknown; time sections express relationships only.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are reversible event-threshold and recovery modules, not surveyed existing buildings or approved new buildings.
assumptions.impact: Their area supports spatial comparison only and cannot be used as a development quantum.

assumptions.statement: The heritage interface line is an abstract design proxy; no heritage protection polygon was digitised from a web page.
assumptions.impact: All heritage distances, construction-control responses, and physical works require competent-authority geometry and specialist review.

assumptions.statement: Event type, frequency, attendance, entrances, queue demand, station acceptance, dispersal time, resident delay, and recovery time have not been measured or approved.
assumptions.impact: They remain variables or proposed acceptance criteria, never achieved outcomes or promised operating capacity.

assumptions.statement: Crowd density, entrance and exit throughput, emergency access, medical cover, stewarding, communication, and temporary-structure safety have no project-specific approved basis.
assumptions.impact: The diagrams cannot certify safe capacity, egress time, event licensing, or emergency performance.

assumptions.statement: Station entrances, train intervals, last-service times, bus capacity, accessible shuttle supply, and disruption plans are absent.
assumptions.impact: No transport mode is claimed to have spare capacity; every dispersal allocation must be recalculated with operators.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios use anonymous aggregate counts and exclude facial recognition, identity scoring, and personal trajectory retention by default.
assumptions.impact: Any additional field requires a separate lawful basis, purpose test, retention rule, and human-access alternative.

assumptions.statement: Three phases express evidence dependencies, not adopted years, public funding, procurement, or construction sequencing.
assumptions.impact: An accountable site and operating entity must be identified before any physical pilot.
